releases.notes:
# Geasd v1.0.0

Initial release. Harvest wheat seeds from grass and ferns in Minecraft **26.1.2**.

## Features
- Hand harvest (right-click): breaks plant — 85% × 1 seed, 15% × 2 seeds
- Shears (right-click): leaves regrowing stubble — 10% × 1 seed, 90% × 2 seeds
- Shears (left-click): permanent break — same seed odds as shears right-click

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**
- Fabric API
- Install on **both client and server** for multiplayer

## Install
Download `geasd-1.0.0.jar` below and place it in your `mods` folder.
